caption: Basilica of Saint Francis, Assisi
composition: Dual-church basilica and arcade on the hillside · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the lower piazza the visitor faces the illuminated basilica rising on the hillside, its Gothic upper church and rose window glowing center-right above the long arcade of warmly lit arches. The slender campanile stands to the left, and dark hills roll behind to the far left under a fading dawn sky. At 06:30 the floodlights still burn against the blue-grey morning, with cypresses at the right edge.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Basilica of Saint Francis in Assisi at twilight
